title: Platform Security Engineer
description_html: Role Overview:   The  C11 Platform Security Engineer  contributes to the end-to-end design, development, and enhancement of high-throughput Java microservices and reverse-proxy components within the Security Gatewayecosystem. Working closely with C12 Lead Engineers and cross-functional teams, the role focuses on building secure, scalable, and resilient security filtering and API routing components.    Key Responsibilities:     1. Security Gateway & Java Microservice Development     Java Application Engineering:  Develop, test, and maintain high-performance, resilient microservices using  Java (Java 11/17+), Spring Boot, Spring Security, and RESTful APIs .   Security Gateway Implementations:  Support reverse-proxy and gateway integrations (e.g., PingAccess, OpenShift/ECS container services) to secure Green Network (GRN) enterprise application traffic.   Authentication & Federation Support:  Assist in implementing modern authentication protocols (SecureSSO, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, COIN tokens) and participate in migrating legacy security protocols (e.g., SiteMinder to OIDC/COIN).   API Routing & Fault Tolerance:  Configure and maintain routing downstream from API Gateways (Apigee / APIM), integrating service discovery (Eureka/CCP) and implementing resilience patterns (resilience4j/circuit breakers, retries, and rate limiters).    2. Software Lifecycle, Quality & Code Execution     Full Development Lifecycle:  Participate actively in all phases of the Agile SDLC (sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives).   Code Quality & Testing:  Write clean, modular, and maintainable Java code adhering to SOLID principles; build comprehensive unit, integration, and contract tests utilizing  JUnit, Mockito, and test containers .   Root Cause Analysis & Defect Remediation:  Investigate, debug, and resolve application bugs, performance bottlenecks, and runtime errors in non-production and production environments.   CI/CD & DevOps Integration:  Build and manage automated build/deploy pipelines using Git, Maven/Gradle, and enterprise CI/CD tools (e.g., Tekton/Lightspeed, Bitbucket/GitHub, OpenShift).    3. Security, Risk & Collaboration     Secure Coding & Vulnerability Remediation:  Ensure all developed code complies with enterprise security benchmarks (SonarQube, Snyk, Checkmarx, MCD scans) and remediate identified vulnerabilities promptly.   Peer Reviews & Collaboration:  Actively participate in peer code reviews, contribute to technical documentation, and collaborate effectively with quality assurance, architecture, and platform operations teams.   Risk & Controls Adherence:  Adhere to Citi’s technology risk and governance policies, applying sound judgment to safeguard firm assets and data.    4. Recommended Qualifications & Education (C11 Level)    Recommended Qualifications:     5–8 years  of hands-on software development experience with enterprise Java applications.  Strong proficiency in  Java (Java 11/17+), Spring Boot, Spring Security, and microservices architecture .  Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS protocols, mutual TLS (mTLS), and web security standards (OWASP Top 10).  Working knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols such as  OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), JWT, and SAML .  Practical experience working with containerized environments ( Docker, Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift ).  Experience with relational/NoSQL databases, SQL querying, and database connection pooling.  Hands-on experience with automated testing tools ( JUnit, Mockito ) and CI/CD tools ( Git, Maven/Gradle, Jenkins/Tekton ).  Good problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills with distributed systems.  Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical issues clearly in an Agile team setup.    Education:     Bachelor’s/University degree  in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.               ------------------------------------------------------               Job Family Group:   Technology             ------------------------------------------------------               Job Family:  Digital Software Engineering         ------------------------------------------------------           Time Type:  Full time   ------------------------------------------------------     Most Relevant Skills   Please see the requirements listed above. ------------------------------------------------------   Other Relevant Skills   For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter. ------------------------------------------------------    Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.             If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review     Accessibility at Citi  . title: Open AI Platform Engineer and Infrastructure Support
description_html: Open AI Platform Engineer and Infrastructure Support    Description -    Job Summary   • This role is responsible for ensuring the technical design, development, installation, and maintenance of state-of-the-art software applications and services for the company. The role plays a crucial role in building technical solutions to help other developers/engineers deliver faster with modern software and application development tools. The role is responsible for technical need analysis and project management. The role builds & maintains relationships with stakeholders across different departments and provide guidance & coaching to reportees in executing their tasks/responsibilities.     Responsibilities     Led OpenAI platform engineering and infrastructure support activities, ensuring platform availability, scalability, and operational excellence.  Managed AI platform integrations, access governance, monitoring, and performance optimization to support enterprise adoption.  Collaborated with security, compliance, and infrastructure teams to deliver a secure and reliable AI ecosystem.  Supported AI enablement initiatives by providing technical guidance, troubleshooting, automation, and platform enhancements.  Data Analytics to support AI Governance and data management  Leads the building of various software development projects and platforms while aligning them with business and security strategies and requirements.  Builds standards, designs, and automates the deployment of software.  Designs and develops solutions that protect and manage software products and data.  Contributes to technology strategy and engineering roadmaps around software engineering; executes strategic software engineering proof of concepts.  Assists in scheduling, determining manpower requirements, and estimating costs to project completion in order to meet user requirements.  Identifies, recommends and implements changes to enhance effectiveness of engineering, implementation and service strategies     Education & Experience Recommended   • Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.  • Typically has 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in software designing & development, software architecture, programming languages, or a related field.     Preferred Certifications   • Programming Language/s Certification (Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, or similar)     Knowledge & Skills    AI /Open AI and AI Strategy   • Agile Methodology  • Amazon Web Services  • Application Programming Interface (API)  • Automation  • C++ (Programming Language)  • Computer Science  • DevOps  • Docker (Software)  • Full Stack Development  • Java (Programming Language)  • JavaScript (Programming Language)  • Kubernetes  • Microservices  • Microsoft Azure  • Python (Programming Language)  • React.js  • Scalability  • Software Development  • Software Engineering  • SQL (Programming Language)     Cross-Org Skills   • Effective Communication  • Results Orientation  • Learning Agility  • Digital Fluency  • Customer Centricity     Impact & Scope   • Impacts function and leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives.     Complexity   • Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of multiple factors.
